notes.trump: Trump trades come from news reports of his OGE 278-T filings (seed/trump_trades.csv), not the full filings, which are scanned PDFs with thousands of lines. Treat them as partial.
notes.disclosure_lag: Members of Congress have up to 45 days to disclose a trade.
